{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(trial.dtypes)
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(trial.head())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print('\nNumber of unique patient_id values:', trial['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Number of total rows:', len(trial))
print('Number of duplicate patient_id values:', len(trial) - trial['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check the severity column
print('\nUnique values in severity column:', trial['severity'].unique())
print('Counts by severity:')
print(trial['severity'].value_counts())"}
